knownExclusions: This source is scoped to DLCP contractor and construction services business license categories and does not represent Industrial Trades, asbestos, permits, enforcement records, local federal-area requirements, or all construction-related business registrations.
SCOUT spans business, property, permit, and licensing information; any future adapter must filter to contractor and construction services records before normalization.
No stable bulk export, parser contract, privacy filter, or redistribution approval has been confirmed.
rateLimitNotes: No adapter is implemented. Prefer official APIs or exports if discovered; do not bypass login walls, CAPTCHAs, or technical controls.
publicRecordsNotes: Official DLCP contractor and construction services metadata only. Absence from this source is not proof that another license, permit, registration, trade credential, or authorization does not exist elsewhere.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: No official contractor and construction services bulk download has been confirmed in this phase.
researchNotes: Registry-only blocked source for DC DLCP contractor and construction services basic business licenses. Future adapter work must filter SCOUT results to General Contractor/Construction Manager, Home Improvement Contractor, and related contractor categories before exposing canonical records.
maintainerNotes: Keep contractor business licenses separate from Industrial Trades, asbestos, permit, inspection, and business-registration records.

researchEvidence.note: Official DLCP Contractor and Construction Services page reviewed; it defines services involving planning, building, altering, repairing, improving, or demolishing structures and lists General Contractor/Construction Manager and Home Improvement Contractor requirements.
Official DLCP Business Licensing FAQ reviewed; it states that BBL and associated public license information can be verified via SCOUT and that subcontractors may need their own BBL.
Official SCOUT lookup retained as the public verification path for Basic Business License information.

blocker.summary: The official verification path is an interactive SCOUT lookup with no adapter-reviewed stable contractor-category filter, table contract, update cadence, privacy filter, or allowed redistribution path.
